mapper.select: SELECT d.product_name AS name, d.product_code AS code FROM stock_data d LEFT JOIN stock_data_system s ON s.stock_data_id = d.id AND s.stock_system = #{system} GROUP BY d.product_name, d.product_code HAVING MIN(COALESCE(s.active, 1)) = 0

SELECT d.product_name AS productName, s.freezer_category AS freezerCategory, s.freezer_position AS freezerPosition FROM stock_data_system s JOIN stock_data d ON d.id = s.stock_data_id WHERE s.stock_system = #{system} ORDER BY d.id ASC
SELECT stock_data_id AS dataId, stock_system AS stockSystem, freezer_category AS freezerCategory, freezer_position AS freezerPosition, price FROM stock_data_system ORDER BY stock_data_id ASC, id ASC
SELECT price FROM stock_data_system WHERE stock_data_id = #{dataId} AND stock_system = #{system}

SELECT s.id, s.stock_data_id AS stockDataId, s.stock_system AS stockSystem, s.freezer_category AS freezer_category, d.product_name AS product_name FROM stock_data_system s JOIN stock_data d ON d.id = s.stock_data_id WHERE FIND_IN_SET(#{name}, REPLACE(s.freezer_category, ' ', '')) > 0
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_data_system SET freezer_category = #{value} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT stock_data_id AS stockDataId, freezer_category AS freezer_category FROM stock_data_system WHERE freezer_category IS NOT NULL AND freezer_category <> ''
